title: Alex Warren Joins UTA Roster Following Hot 100-Topping ‘Ordinary’ and Grammy Nomination
summary: UTA will work to secure opportunities for Warren across film, television, content creation, podcasting, publishing and brand partnerships.
contentText:
Alex Warren has signed with United Talent Agency for global representation, the agency announced Tuesday (May 5).

UTA will work to secure opportunities for Warren across film, television, content creation, podcasting, publishing and brand partnerships, in addition to his music career.

The singer-songwriter continues to be represented by Odd Projects, King, Holmes, Paterno & Soriano LLP, The LEDE Company, and The Team for touring in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

The signing comes at a career high for Warren, whose breakthrough single “Ordinary” topped the Billboard Hot 100 for 10 weeks, the Billboard Global 200 for 10 weeks, and the U.K. Singles Chart for 13 weeks — breaking a 70-year-old record previously held by Elvis Presley for the longest-running No. 1 single in U.K. chart history.

The track also set the record for the longest-running No. 1 in U.S. Pop Radio history at 16 weeks, and became the top-selling song released in 2025 in the U.S. by total units, with over 2.9 billion streams. Warren was named Billboard’s Top New Artist of 2025.

The “Ordinary” hitmaker’s debut album You’ll Be Alright, Kid , released July 18, 2025, has been certified Platinum by the RIAA and spent 13 non-consecutive weeks in the top 10 of the Billboard 200, debuting in the top five. It is the seventh most-streamed album globally on Spotify for 2025 and includes multiple Hot 100-charting tracks including “Ordinary,” “Eternity,” “Bloodline” featuring Jelly Roll, “On My Mind” featuring ROSÉ and “Burning Down” with Joe Jonas.

Warren earned a Grammy nomination for Best New Artist at the 68th Annual Grammy Awards and won Best New Artist at the 2025 MTV VMAs.

Warren is currently on his sold-out global arena tour “Finding Family on the Road,” with nearly 850,000 tickets sold across Europe, the U.K., the U.S., Asia and Australia. His most recent releases include new singles “Fever Dream” and “Fine Place to Die.”
